question.text: If: \(p\) Raju is tall and \(q\) : Raju is intelligent, then the symbolic statement \(\sim p \vee q\) means

options.text: Raju is not tall or he is intelligent.
Raju is tall or he is intelligent
Raju is not tall and he is intelligent
Raju is not tall implies he is intelligent

solution.text: \(\sim \mathrm{p} \vee \mathrm{q}:\) Raju is not tall or he is intelligent.
